description: This file defines an Angular service 'ApiClientService' that provides methods for interacting with backend APIs, including health checks, activity logs, metrics, and data pagination. It includes type definitions for API responses and internal logic for fallback data.

classes.name: ApiClientService
classes.description: Angular service providing API interaction methods, including health checks, activity logs, metrics, and paginated data retrieval with fallback mechanisms.

methods.name: getBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the base URL for API calls, derived from environment variables.

methods.name: buildUrl
methods.description: Constructs full API endpoint URL based on base URL and provided path.

methods.name: getHealth$
methods.description: Fetches health status from the backend, normalizing various response shapes.

methods.name: getDashboardStatus$
methods.description: Retrieves overall dashboard status including health, API base, WebSocket URL, and environment.

methods.name: getActivity$
methods.description: Fetches activity log items, providing sample data if endpoint is unavailable.

methods.name: fallbackMetrics
methods.description: Generates fallback metrics data with simulated request and error series.

methods.name: normalizeMetrics
methods.description: Normalizes API response into DashboardMetrics format, handling various data shapes.

methods.name: getDashboardMetrics$
methods.description: Fetches dashboard metrics, falling back to generated data if API call fails.

methods.name: fallbackDataRecords
methods.description: Creates sample DataRecord array for fallback data.

methods.name: applyFallbackDataQuery
methods.description: Filters, sorts, and paginates fallback DataRecord data based on query parameters.

methods.name: normalizeDataPage
methods.description: Normalizes API response into DataPage format, handling various response shapes.

methods.name: getDataPage$
methods.description: Retrieves paginated data records from API, with fallback to local data.
